introduction: New York HEAP helps eligible households with heating costs. Regular, emergency and equipment assistance have separate intake rules and funding windows.
description: New York HEAP helps eligible households with heating costs. Regular, emergency and equipment assistance have separate intake rules and funding windows.

sections.who: Household income and circumstances affect eligibility. Confirm current-season rules with your HEAP district.
sections.get: Assistance may support fuel or utility costs. Emergency help requires direct district contact and case review.
sections.docs:
• Income and household records.
  • Residence and heating-account details.
  • Shutoff or fuel-emergency information.
sections.apply:
1. Check current opening

    Erie County anticipates regular heating intake on November 2, 2026. Broome County confirms heating-equipment repair/replacement and clean-and-tune benefits open October 1, 2026. Check OTDA HEAP or your district for the component you need; these dates do not establish that every component is open.

  2. Use the local route

    Follow state instructions for myBenefits outside NYC or HRA in NYC.

  3. Report an emergency directly

    Explain loss of fuel or a disconnect date to the district.
sections.after: Do not arrange equipment work before asking about approval. Track notices and status with the district.
